title: Anthropic IPO raises over $81 billion in largest offering on record, topping SpaceX
description: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the guided $70–$78 range, and upsized the offering to about 980 million shares, raising roughly $81 billion. The pricing values the company at about $1.5 trillion, making it the largest IPO on record. Shares are set to begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT on November 19.

title: Google's latest midtier model Gemini 4 Neon is three times faster than Carbon and wins on some metrics
description: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a midtier model it says completes most tasks about three times faster than Gemini 4 Carbon at roughly 60% lower cost. Google's own benchmarks show Neon beating Carbon on some tasks, while independent testing by Artificial Analysis placed it slightly behind leading frontier models on its Intelligence Index.

title: Ignite 2026: Building the frontier ecosystem
description: Microsoft's official Ignite 2026 post outlines its agent-centric strategy, positioning Agent 365 as a control plane for enterprise agents alongside Microsoft IQ, Foundry continuous-improvement tooling and partner integrations. The company frames the announcements as building an ecosystem for 'frontier firms' running humans and agents together.

title: Southeast Asia’s data center boom leaned on Chinese demand. New U.S. rules put that pipeline at risk
description: A U.S. Commerce Department interim rule now requires data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia to obtain a license to buy advanced AI chips. Analysts say the rule could slow the region's data center buildout, which has relied heavily on demand from Chinese customers.

title: JPMorgan is working on AI agent transactions that don’t involve humans
description: JPMorgan and Hyundai Card completed a proof-of-concept in which AI agents executed simulated foreign exchange transactions without direct human intervention. The pilot is part of the bank's broader exploration of agent-to-agent payments infrastructure.

title: Google upgrades Gemini’s agentic Task mode with new model, e-commerce features
description: Google moved Gemini's agentic Task mode onto its Gemini 4 Hydrogen model and added new e-commerce capabilities. The feature is now free for users in the U.S., Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia and India.

title: Sam Altman warns against a future where AI, not humans, calls the shots
description: Speaking at the NYT DealBook Summit, OpenAI's Sam Altman and Greg Brockman said a gradual handover of decision-making to AI systems would be a serious mistake. Brockman also cautioned that chain-of-thought monitoring may become less effective as models grow more capable.

title: HPC meets AI agents as Google Cloud targets time to discovery
description: At SC26, Google Cloud detailed how it is combining high-performance computing infrastructure with AI agents to shorten scientific research cycles. The pitch targets research institutions and enterprises running simulation-heavy workloads.
